abstract.para: The &rmt; role in Ansible (provided via the ansible-rmt-server package and integrated into &suse; deployment automation) automates the end-to-end installation, provisioning, and configuration of an &rmt; instance on &sles; &sles4sap; .

topic.para: You can use this role to:

listitem.para: Set the global &selnx; mode to enforcing, permissive or disabled using the selinux_state variable.
Define persistent rules for file system labeling (file contexts) for custom directories or applications.
Define security types for non-standard network ports, allowing services to listen on them without violating the policy.
Manage the mapping between Linux user accounts and specific &selnx; user identities.

example.title: Deploy and Configure the &suse; &rmt; Server
example.screen:
--- - name: Deploy and Configure SUSE RMT Server hosts: rmt_servers become: true
tasks: - name: Install rmt-server and MariaDB packages community.general.zypper: name: - rmt-server - mariadb state: present
- name: Ensure MariaDB service is started and enabled ansible.builtin.systemd: name: mariadb state: started enabled: true
- name: Create RMT database in MariaDB community.mysql.mysql_db: name: rmt state: present login_unix_socket: /run/mysql/mysql.sock
- name: Create RMT database user and grant privileges community.mysql.mysql_user: name: "{{ rmt_db_username }}" password: "{{ rmt_db_password }}" priv: "rmt.*:ALL" host: "localhost" state: present login_unix_socket: /run/mysql/mysql.sock
- name: Configure /etc/rmt.conf ansible.builtin.copy: dest: /etc/rmt.conf owner: _rmt group: nginx mode: "0640" content: | database: host: localhost database: rmt username: {{ rmt_db_username }} password: {{ rmt_db_password }}
scc: username: {{ rmt.RMT_ORGANIZATION_USERNAME }} password: {{ rmt.RMT_ORGANIZATION_PASSWORD }} sync_systems: true
log_level: rails: info notify: Restart RMT services
- name: Run initial RMT database migration ansible.builtin.command: cmd: rmt-cli sync register: rmt_sync_result changed_when: rmt_sync_result.rc == 0
- name: Enable and start RMT and Nginx services and timers ansible.builtin.systemd: name: "{{ item }}" state: started enabled: true loop: - rmt-server.service - rmt-server-sync.timer - rmt-server-mirror.timer - nginx.service
handlers: - name: Restart RMT services ansible.builtin.systemd: name: rmt-server.service state: restarted
